name: Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
description: Detects execution of PowerShell with Base64 encoded command arguments (-enc, -encodedcommand), frequently used by adversaries to bypass command-line inspection.
explanation: Adversaries commonly leverage PowerShell's -EncodedCommand parameter to execute obfuscated scripts without writing to disk.
investigation_steps: Decode the Base64 command string found in the actor.cmdline argument.
Check parent process to determine what launched PowerShell.
Inspect network connections from this PID for external outbound C2 traffic.
